facts.fact: StackAdapt reports that 65.3% of Americans (218.6M people) are listening to digital audio monthly in 2021, citing a chart attributed to eMarketer.
facts.quote: In 2021, 65.3% of Americans (218.6M) are listening to digital audio monthly.

facts.fact: Edison Research found that podcast listeners typically earn a household income above $100k per year.
facts.quote: found that podcast listeners typically have university level education, are employed, and earn a household income above $100k per year
